text: I took my cat to the vet. The vet was inexperienced and didn't even notice how weak my cat was. They gave a strong intravenous injection, causing my cat to go into shock at the hospital. They couldn't save her. The cost wasn't the problem, but what I got was my cat's dead body. It's like I brought my cat to die instead of getting treatment. The service was terrible. They just handed me the dead cat without taking any responsibility or explaining anything. One visit is enough. Think about it yourselves.

text: I took my dog ​​to this hospital in 2023 for uterine inflammation. They removed her uterus and spayed her. However, three months later, she went into heat again. When I inquired, the hospital said that perhaps the ovaries weren't completely removed and some small fragments might remain, but they assured me she wouldn't get pregnant. Two years later, her ovaries became reinfected. I asked for accountability, but there was none because the vet who performed the surgery had left the hospital and I was told to contact them myself. I figured I wouldn't have to pay for the surgery at the original hospital anyway. So I went to another, more skilled vet. The conclusion was, it wasn't that the ovaries weren't completely removed, but that they weren't removed at all in the first place. Consider this carefully. I'm definitely never going back to that hospital again.
